title: feat: grant paid pollen through quest rewards
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `balanceBucket` (`tier` | `pack`, default `tier`) to the admin quest-grant request, so a bonus can pay paid Pollen
- Echoes the granted bucket in the response, so an operator can confirm which balance a money-moving grant hit
- No other change needed: the reward ledger stores the bucket, `claimReward()` already credits `pack_balance`, and `rewardIconKind()` already renders pack rewards with the paid icon
- Paid Pollen is the only bucket paid-only requests can spend, which is what a contributor bonus in `pack` actually unlocks

Checks:
- `npx vitest run test/quest-grants.test.ts test/quests.test.ts` — 33 passed, including a new pack grant → claim → `pack_balance` credit
- `npx biome check` clean; `tsc --noEmit` clean for Worker code

gist.headline: Quest rewards found a wallet
gist.blurb: Contributor bonuses can now arrive as Paid Pollen, not just tier balance. The quest garden has learned which little jar to fill.
gist.summary: Admin quest grants now accept a `balanceBucket` of `tier` or `pack` (defaulting to `tier`), letting contributor bonuses credit Paid Pollen through the existing reward claim flow.
gist.impact: Contributors can receive `pack`-bucket rewards that credit `pack_balance`, giving them Paid Pollen for requests that specifically spend that balance, while operators can verify the granted bucket in the response.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy quest-reward station with a quest board and two labeled pollen jars: a regular tier jar and a special Paid Pollen pack jar. Polli, wearing a tiny accountant visor, carefully places a reward token into the paid jar while a friendly CRT robot confirms the selected bucket on its screen; small code-plants and flowers make the accounting corner feel like a garden.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, chunky retro sprites, subtle CRT glow, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
